name: Elevate Uranium Limited
content: Elevate Uranium Limited is an Australian-based uranium exploration company with a significant portfolio of assets in Namibia and Australia. The company is focused on the exploration and development of its uranium projects, leveraging its proprietary U-pgrade™ beneficiation process, which is designed to significantly reduce capital and operating costs by concentrating uranium ore. With a large resource base in Namibia, a premier uranium mining jurisdiction, and additional projects in the Northern Territory and Western Australia, Elevate Uranium is well-positioned to capitalize on the growing global demand for nuclear energy.

Officers

Murray HillMay 2012

Managing Director and Chief Executive Officer

Mr Hill is a highly experienced mining executive with over 35 years' experience in the mining industry. He is a metallurgist and has extensive experience in the design, construction and operation of mining projects. He has held senior executive roles with several ASX listed companies.

Shane McBrideNovember 2018

Chief Financial Officer and Company Secretary

Mr McBride is a Fellow of CPA Australia, a Fellow of Governance Institute of Australia and a Member of the Australian Institute of Company Directors. He has over 40 years' experience in the mining industry in senior management and executive roles.

Andy LloydNovember 2018

Non-Executive Chairman

Mr Lloyd has over 30 years' experience in the mining and resources industry. He has held senior executive roles with Rio Tinto, including as Managing Director of Rio Tinto's uranium business. He is currently a non-executive director of several other ASX listed companies.

Stephen MannJune 2021

Non-Executive Director

Mr Mann is a geologist with over 45 years' experience in the mining industry. He has held senior executive roles with several ASX listed companies, including as Managing Director of Areva Resources Australia.
